title: 第291章 硝筒炸断墙根铁，笑面藏锋驿外兵
slug: 边军从领取罪女开始一统天下
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“先生放心。”岳大鹏拿大拇指往城东一比，

“这石聋子三天两头地崩，满城都听腻了。昨日那一声多吓人？本地人连眼皮都没抬，只当那疯子又犯了癫。咱们这一响混进去，他们顶多骂一句‘石聋子又崩上了’，断想不到是俺们。”

陈醉微微颔首。

“万一崩不开呢？”

“那就没别的话讲了。”岳大鹏的手按上了刀柄，“硬拼。”

陈醉看着他。

“几时动手？”

“不等天黑。”岳大鹏站起身，

“趁这会儿他们还当俺们是瓮里的鳖，打他们一个冷不防。”

......

三个顶替陈醉的弟兄，各自把一身陈醉的衣裳掖进怀里，错开时辰，前后脚出了院子。

守门的铁骊兵照旧没拿正眼瞧他们。

寻了处背人的墙旮旯，三人才把陈醉的行头换上身。

老林扯了扯身上文绉绉的袍子，浑身不自在，到底没吭声。

天色将晚。

依着岳大鹏的指点，三人摸到了石喉塞东南角。

墙头垛口后，立着两个铁骊兵。

老林抬手，按住身后两人。

他与身旁一人端起连弩，抬手瞄住墙头。

弩机响了两下。

两个铁骊兵一前一后栽倒。

一个翻下墙，落在墙根。

一个倒在垛口后，没再动。

三人伏住，等了片刻。

墙上再没人探头。

墙根底下，果然有个洞，刚够一个人侧着身子转过去。

洞当中立着一根拇指粗的铁条，上下都嵌在石头里。

老林蹲下身，扒开洞口的淤泥和烂草。铁条的根脚顺着往下，一直扎进城墙底的石基里。

“老林……这真能成么？”

三人里数他年纪轻些，嗓子发紧。

“试试看。”

老林没回头，“去搬块石头来，把这物件压在底下。”

“压着它做甚？”那人一时没回过味来。

老林拿着那截竹筒，半晌没言语，想起了小时候的光景。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Don't worry, sir." Yue Dapeng pointed his thumb towards the east of the city.

"The deaf man is collapsing every three days. The whole city is tired of hearing about it. How scary was that sound yesterday? The locals didn't even raise their eyelids. They just thought that the lunatic had gone crazy again. When we blended in, the most they could say was, 'The deaf man collapsed again,' and they never thought it was us."

Chen Zui nodded slightly.

“万一崩不开呢？”

"Then there's nothing else to say." Yue Dapeng put his hand on the handle of the knife, "Fight hard."

Chen Zui looked at him.

"When will we start?"

“不等天黑。”岳大鹏站起身，

"While they still think we are turtles in a urn, hit them off guard."

...

The three brothers who replaced Chen Zui each tucked Chen Zui's clothes into their arms, staggered the time, and walked out of the yard.

守门的铁骊兵照旧没拿正眼瞧他们。

After searching for a nook and cranny behind the wall, the three of them changed into Chen Zui's clothes.

Old Lin tugged on his elegant robe, feeling uncomfortable all over, but remained silent.

It's getting late.

Following Yue Dapeng's instructions, the three of them touched the southeast corner of the stone throat plug.

墙头垛口后，立着两个铁骊兵。

老林抬手，按住身后两人。

He and the person next to him raised their repeating crossbows and raised their hands to aim at the wall.

The crossbow rang twice.

两个铁骊兵一前一后栽倒。

一个翻下墙，落在墙根。

一个倒在垛口后，没再动。

三人伏住，等了片刻。

No one poked their head into the wall anymore.

There was indeed a hole under the wall, just big enough for a person to turn sideways.

In the middle of the hole stood an iron bar as thick as a thumb, embedded in the stone from top to bottom.

Old Lin squatted down and dug open the mud and rotten grass at the entrance of the cave.The roots of the iron bars went down and penetrated into the stone foundation at the bottom of the city wall.

“老林……这真能成么？”

三人里数他年纪轻些，嗓子发紧。

"Try it."

Lao Lin didn't look back, "Go and move a stone and put this object under it."

"What are you doing with it?" The man didn't realize it for a moment.

Lao Lin held the piece of bamboo tube and was speechless for a long time, remembering his childhood.
